data.body: Cross-epic ownership note (2026-09-07): the overlap story granitic-realisable-dolphin edits `src/rebar/llm/config.py` (`:47,55,114-143,408-426,505,521`, deletions), `src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py` (`:133-138`, deletes `:211-317`) and `rebar.toml` (`:32-42`, deletes `:205-216`) in the same regions this story adds the `[llm.evals]` reader (`evals_corpus_root`, `replay_dir`, `default_ledger_path`) and its re-exports. Its "the config epic owns every other line" sentence mis-named the co-editor; it is this story. Rule: neither story waits; whichever lands second rebases onto the other's version of those three files and re-runs `make verify`; this story's `[llm.evals]` table goes directly under the surviving `[llm]` header in `rebar.toml`.
